verdict.rationale: Salv documents user-configured clearance rules that auto-close alerts meeting conditions you set, with an audit trail. It also re-screens customers automatically several times a day as lists change, so some automations do run in the background without manual action. These are fixed, domain-specific automations rather than a general automation builder, and the re-screening cadence is not described as user-configurable. Missing for 10: a general-purpose automation/workflow builder, user-defined schedules or triggers beyond alert clearance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Clearance rules close alerts that meet conditions you set, from the library or your own, and every auto-closed alert stays on the record as an audit trail.
re-screened automatically several times a day as lists change
Set an alert suppression interval so a repeating customer doesn't re-alert every day.
